comment: Dr. Kumas is a bit difficult to understand at times but is overall a great professor. I had to teach some mateirial to myself because she explains something she isn't good at explaining things in a multiple ways. She also expects you to have a good background in chemistry even in intro courses so if you dont be prepared to be confused sometimes.
Dr. Kumas is a very sweet prof. However, she is not the best explainer. I think she is one of the teachers that is really smart but does not know how to explain things simply

I thought she was a wonderful professor. Her written notes are very helpful and available online if you miss class. I thought her grading was tough but fair. She is extremely sweet but will also be honest about your shortcomings in terms of the content. She will cold call, but she will help you get to the answer and it's okay if you don't know.

Kumas is a very easy A in lab in my opinion. If you do the work well, and put in effort doing the lab reports, and honestly just submit the quizzes and labs on time, you are going to do well. Also, she grades pretty fast so you can fix mistakes made on prior labs. 10/10 DO TAKE!
She cares a lot about her student. A lot of availability and flexibility. Highly recommend to take from her.

Dr. Kumas is a good teacher and cares a lot about her students. Her lectures are a little hard to follow, but it's manageable. The content is hard, and there is a lot to learn. She's super helpful in office hours and a great teacher for the lab, too. It's low-key hard to get a good grade because the exams are weighted so heavily, though. HARD CLASS

Dr. Kumas is a good teacher. She cares about what she teaches, and though she can be confusing at times, if you actually pay attention to the lectures, it all makes sense in the end. Her homework and tests arent insanely difficult either. Taking notes is super important though because it'll help you a lot studying for the tests.

Dr. Kumas is a total sweetheart! She is a lenient grader for tests and gives as many partial credit points as she can. Lecture can be boring, filling in a note worksheet she gives. She has extra credit options to help with grades. Homework can be extremely difficult, harder than the material we get on the tests. Overall great professor!

She clearly puts a lot of effort into preparing for Chem 141. I highly recommend her if you're serious about studying. The class is challenging, and it's essential to complete the homework to do well. She offers bonus points and treats students kindly, which makes you feel great. Additionally, she holds numerous study sessions before tests.

I took AP chemistry and got a 4 and still ended this class with a B+. Enough said. I had little to no idea why she taught what she taught. She offered a lot of extra credit to the point where students who were failing got a higher grade than I did. She is a sweetheart, however, this class was extremely unfair to the kids who knew what was going on.

She delivers exceptionally high-quality lectures and shows a genuine concern for her students. However, it's worth noting that this class demands a significant amount of preparation for exams. It's definitely a challenging course, but the rigorous studying pays off as you gain a deep understanding of the material that benefits you in other classes.

Dr. Kumas is the perfect lab instructor for Chem206Lab. She is such a sweet lady, and she truly cares about her students and makes an effort to know them. Very accessible outside class, and will help you with any procedure during lab. She wants you to succeed, but if things go wrong, she is very understanding. She deserves the world!

She is terrible at explaining topics and takes months to grade work so you'll go into exams with NO feedback.HW is ridiculously hard and never has anything to do with lecture and they're graded on accuracy.Exams are a nightmare and don't relate to class.I never feel prepared in this class, the only way to get through is with a tutor to do her job.

I took Dr. Kumas for my organic chem 1 lab and she was awesome. She would explain any concept you needed help with and gives access to supplemental material for us to utilize. Her lab is very homework heavy, every week there is generally a prelab quiz, several workshops, proficiency quizzes and a lab report due, but she is flexible and very caring

Dr. Kumas is the best lab instructor I've had so far at UR. She is the sweetest woman you'll ever meet, and she is so willing to help you out if you are struggling. Orgo labs are tough, but Dr. Kumas really has your back when it comes to helping you analyze data from lab. She is an easy grader and accepts late work sometimes without point deduction

Dr. Kumas is so wholesome and sweet. As a lab instructor, she provides clear instructions, is always willing to help, and even goes out of her way to make learning materials so that lab goes as smoothly as possible. If you are ever confused she is super accessible for help, and as long as you give lab good effort you will do fine.

I love Dr. Kumas! She is a great choice because she is always clear on grading and feedback. She will absolutely try her best to help her students, and is super caring and inspirational! She is also super approachable so if you need a lot of help, dont be afraid to ask. As long as you pay attention, and stay engaged, you will do well.

I had Dr. Kumas for both Orgo 1 and Orgo 2 lab. She is very patient and calm which are great qualities to have in the lab! She is really approachable and willing to help. I wish I could take lab with her again! It was a great experience!

Dr. Kumas is a solid choice to take for Orgo lab. She is willing to help students and holds various office hours. She is currently only teaching labs, but will teach the CHEM205 lecture next semester. I had a little bit of a hard time understanding her throughout the lab, but in the end, I made it work and she helps all lab groups one-on-one.

She is the BEST! Dr. Kumas is a visiting lecturer (teaching only labs) right now, pretty sure she is staying though. She helps SO much outside of class, and is always willing to help for in class and out of class problems. Really understanding and does not treat you like an idiot if you mess up or have questions. One of the best lab professors ever
